posts.name: WarrenAC
posts.cooked:
Just got the unlock.  I went looking for the log in Android, but I guess it deletes once the game is over.

Three heroes,  order: Team Leader Tachyon, Dark Visionary, Unity in Freedom Tower.

Unlocked on Chokepoint's turn. 

My guess (which is almost completely wrong given how this game went) was that it had something to do with the number of cards in Chokepoint's area and/or environment vs. Unity's play area (equipment) after she flipped,  so I used Visionary to get her to flip ASAP and then did my best to blow up all her stuff and keep her from getting new things.  No dice,  had Chokepoint wipe the environment a couple times so almost nothing there,  and she was down to two cards,  while Unity had two Modular Workbenches,  two Volatile parts, at times had Supply Crates and Scrap Metal in addition to over ten bots to no avail.  Unity had way more bots than Chokepoint+Environment,  and even had more equipment a couple times than Choke+enviro. After that I went for playing one of each bot,  all the freedom five bots were out,  and then raptor bot was the last bot type I hadn't put out yet,  and then I gave up and put all the other bots out.  All the golems were at full health going into the second to last turn.  Caspit's playground was out for a while and Visionary was in cocoon mode tanking for Chokepoint by the end. I dodged a lot of gear stealing with Visionary before she cocooned so Chokepoint never had more than four hero cards, although I never got her to flip back.

Near the end, Caspit's Playground got covered by an Entry Point, no other environment.  Chokepoint played an Augmented Energy Field.  I'm pretty sure up to this point I hadn't destroyed any of her ongoings using Bee Bot - I destroyed one using Blinding Speed,  and the Shocking Animation was put on a Supply Crate. I'm pretty sure I only used Bee-bot on Frost's environment card.

Last Round:

Team Leader Tachyon Nimble strikes a Bee-Bot,  which I used to blow up the Augmented Energy Field.  Bee Bot hits Visionary, blows up the Field and then I realise that the Volatile parts kick in and Unity almost takes out Chokepoint - she goes down to 1 HP after the dual Volatile Parts hit.

Visionary stays in cocoon.

Unity does an Inspired repair into a Robot Reclamation (first time using this) to take back Bee Bot. I put out a Pylon.  I then use Modular Workbench to put out a Bee-Bot. The bots hit Visionary. 

Environment adds a Training Simulator and then Unity unlocked on Chokepoint's turn. She plays Shocking Animation, which I put in the Pylon. She destroyed her last hero card in her play area, which was Visionary's.

And then TLT suckerpunches Chokepoint in the face.

Ending suggests that Bee-Bot destroying one of Chokepoint's ongoings may be important.  Something about playing a lot of Unity's cards and destroying Chokepoint's stuff seems to at least let you luck into the unlock.  My guess would be:

A three hero team game against Chokepoint, Unity must be present. 

Chokepoint must flip.

Bee-bot must destroy one of Chokepoint's ongoings.

All the bots must have entered play once.

Modular Workbench and Construction Pylon must be out when Chokepoint plays a card.
